small_guidance:
- The standalone double_mish kernel is memory-bound and wastes a full read/write of the conv output; the conv itself dominates at ~18ms. Tuning BLOCK_SIZE/num_warps on the mish kernel will not close the gap.
- If keeping the structure, at least bump BLOCK_SIZE to 8192 with num_warps=8, num_stages=2, and use `tl.softplus`-style fused form via `tl.log1p(tl.exp(x))` guarded by x>20 (already done) — marginal gains only.
- Real win requires fusing both mish activations into the conv epilogue so the conv output is never written to global memory before activation.
large_guidance:
- Replace `nn.Conv2d` with a custom Triton im2col-GEMM kernel: program tile over (N, OC_tile, OH*OW_tile), accumulate over (IC*KH*KW) with implicit im2col index math. Fuse bias add and both Mish activations into the epilogue on the fp32 accumulator before storing, eliminating two extra full tensor read/writes.
- Use channels_last (NHWC) layout so the GEMM-K dimension (IC*KH*KW) is contiguous along IC; pre-permute weights to (OC, KH, KW, IC) once in __init__.
- Autotune over BLOCK_M∈{64,128}, BLOCK_N∈{32,64,128}, BLOCK_K∈{16,32,64} with num_warps∈{4,8}, num_stages∈{2,3}; for 3x3 unit-stride no-pad conv on H=W=256, OC=128, IC=64, the K dim is 576 and output spatial is 254*254=64516, so favor large BLOCK_N tiles.
